component.name: Jellyfin Kattri
component.summary: A fast, native Jellyfin desktop client

description.p: Jellyfin Kattri is a native desktop client for Jellyfin. It draws its interface with egui on an OpenGL surface and plays video with libmpv in the same window: no web view, no JavaScript UI, and no server changes.

Credentials stay in the system credential store, and the player receives a session-scoped loopback relay URL instead of your server token. Browsing, search, libraries, music, Live TV, downloads, SyncPlay and an optional 10-foot interface are included, with keyboard and gamepad control.

screenshot.caption: Home screen with continue watching and library rows

description.p: First stable release. SyncPlay group pause, seek and unpause work while stream-only reporting is off, a queued start joins at the current position, and two-client drift measured p95 77 ms.
Accessible row cards and stream-address names, bounded episode pages, local video in the theater player, and explicit subtitle and Dolby Vision policies.
Library tabs, album batch downloads, live and per-title subtitle styles, subtitle burn-in, idle screensaver and theme media.
LAN discovery and jellyfin:// links, administration, SyncPlay, custom request headers and update manifest fetching.
Private CA and mutual-TLS support, a maximized start and a redesigned player bar.
